covers: FIXTURE of the contract's own tests: the VGA sequencer's two ports

entries.name: sequencer index
entries.description: Selects the sequencer register the next data write reaches.
entries.behaviour: A write selects a register of the sequencer; a read gives the selection back.

entries.name: sequencer data
entries.description: Carries the value of the sequencer register the index selected.
entries.behaviour: A write sets the selected register; a read gives it.
